method: Batch 53 (b53df): the PlayerDamageProbe double (real EntityPlayerMP, Survival, real inventory) owns a real ItemInWorldManager (mx) over a world double. Ops are the C07 packets of NetHandlerPlayServer: s = status 0 (mx.a(x,y,z,face)), f = status 2 (mx.a(x,y,z), then the handler resends S23 when the cell is not air), t = the server tick (mx.a()). r/ra = Block.getPlayerRelativeBlockHardness of the cell before/after the op (null for air). A step {o:"t",n,p,e,c,cur} folds n ticks: p = crack updates, e = "j:event" for non-crack events of tick j, c = the cell afterwards, cur = curblockDamage. Events: aux|2001|id = the break effect, remove|id = setBlockToAir, S23|x|y|z|id = the resend, partial|v = destroyBlockInWorldPartially. Batch 54 (b54da): the da-* records run every tick as a step and add the abort (status 1, mx.c) and the crack stages (partial|v, v -1 clears). Not run: the C07 distance check and spawn protection (NetHandlerPlayServer, ported in server-handlers.js), harvest drops.
